category_note: Hand-built product UI from repo source (no URL capture), so the search-driven webpage category does not apply. Closest vocabulary: webpage cursor + callout primitives.
style: data-peek motion kit: dark devtool, monospace-native, quiet confidence. Consistent with the v0.26 teaser approval scene, tighter and looped.
font: Geist Variable + Geist Mono Variable (local woff2)

reused_techniques.oversized-cursor: macOS arrow path, tip-anchored transform origin, glide then press scale 0.9 and release
reused_techniques.tracing-beam: glowing dash travelling an SVG path via stroke-dashoffset (MCP link pulse)
reused_techniques.code-terminal-run: mono step-typed reveal and solid caret on the idle prompt

layout.header: meta row at y 80: 'data-peek · MCP server' left, 'reads run free · writes wait for you' right
layout.terminal: left panel x 100 to 830, generic 'agent' terminal, transcript + bottom prompt
layout.window: right panel from x 960, bleeds off right and bottom edges (cropped data-peek window)
layout.dialog: centred over the window, vertically aligned with the terminal, >= 80 px from edges

copy.dialog_title: Agent wants to run a write statement
copy.dialog_description: An MCP client is asking to execute this on prod-orders. It auto-rejects in 60 seconds.

beats.motion: hold; caret solid on prompt (loop point)
tool header slide_left; SQL typewriter steps; status line fade; MCP beam dash travels terminal -> window
window dims; dialog scale 0.94 -> 1 + y 36 -> 0, expo.out 0.45 s
pointer glides in (power3.out), press (button 0.96, cursor 0.9), success green flash + ring burst, dialog resolves (power2.in)
beam returns window -> terminal in green; tag flips to approved; result line slide_left with green check
write block fades up and out (power2.in); caret returns solid; exact frame-0 state from 5.3 s

content.ambient: one radial glow breathing on sine.inOut, yoyo over the full 6 s so it returns to its frame-0 scale

removed: countdown ring chip (2026-10-02): showed UI the app does not have; the dialog copy carries the timeout
